data.title: Morgan Stanley Limits Redemptions Again at Nearly $7 Billion Private Credit Fund
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Morgan Stanley again capped redemptions at its nearly $7 billion private credit fund in the third quarter, with redemption requests more than twice the amount the fund was willing to buy back. North Haven Private Income Fund set its redemption cap at 5%, while investors requested redemptions for 11.4% of shares, roughly unchanged from the previous three months. In the three quarters through September, the fund completed about $479 million in buybacks, and nearly two-thirds of the requests came from investors restricted in the previous two rounds.

data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang again rejected AI doomsday claims, saying the technology will not pose an existential threat to humanity and that the probability of a world-ending scenario in 2030 is 0%.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Musk Says AI Could Double U.S. Economic Growth Next Year
data.description:
Elon Musk said artificial intelligence will roughly double U.S. economic growth next year, lifting it from about 2% to about 4%. According to NS3.AI, the forecast is above Federal Reserve policymakers’ 2.4% growth projection for 2027, released on September 16.

The claim comes as California advances AI oversight, while Geoffrey Hinton warned lawmakers that time to address AI risks may be limited.

data.title: AI | OpenAI Sees $278 Billion Negative Free Cash Flow Through 2030
data.description: OpenAI expects negative free cash flow to total $278 billion from 2026 through the end of 2030, according to Bloomberg. The figure was cited in materials shared in July as part of a major computing deal.

data.title: International Atomic Energy Agency: Drone Hits Cooling Tower at Russian Nuclear Plant
data.description: According to Sina Finance, the International Atomic Energy Agency said it learned that a cooling tower at one reactor unit at Russia's Kursk Nuclear Power Plant was hit by a drone on September 17. The agency said the reactor unit was operating at the time, its operating status was not affected, and no fire occurred. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi said any attack on nuclear facilities is unacceptable and reiterated that all parties should exercise maximum military restraint to prevent the risk of a nuclear accident.

data.title: U.S. Federal Judge Rules Trump Administration Illegally Ended $7 Billion Solar Grant Program
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, a federal judge in Rhode Island ruled on Friday that the Trump administration illegally ended a $7 billion solar grant program. The Environmental Protection Agency canceled the Solar for All program last August after funds had already been allocated nationwide to help low-income communities invest in solar power and other home upgrades, and the move was immediately challenged in court by stakeholders in multiple states.

data.title: U.S. Officials: Military Death Toll in Iran War Exceeds Pentagon Public Data
data.description: According to Sina Finance, citing CCTV News, six U.S. officials familiar with internal Pentagon casualty statistics said U.S. military deaths during the ongoing Iran war in the Middle East were actually higher than the number publicly disclosed by the Pentagon. Five of the officials said at least 22 service members had died, four more than the figure shown by the Pentagon's Defense Casualty Analysis System. Another official said 23 U.S. service members had died since the joint U.S.-Israel military strike on Iran on February 28, adding that not all undisclosed deaths were directly related to the conflict.

data.title: JOOPITER Lists Michael Jordan 1998 Finals Jersey With $10 Million Opening Bid
data.description:
Caitlin Donovan, global head of sales at JOOPITER, said sports memorabilia is one of the fastest-growing parts of the collectibles market, according to Bloomberg.

JOOPITER, the digital auction house founded by Pharrell Williams in 2022, has put a game-worn Michael Jordan jersey from Game 3 of the 1998 NBA Finals up for auction with an opening bid of $10 million.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash launches as Alibaba Cloud expands multimodal agent capabilities
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Alibaba Cloud's next-generation native full-modal model Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash has launched, with its core goal to improve agent capabilities in real-world productivity scenarios and push full-modal models from understanding multimodal content to planning tasks, calling tools, and completing creation. Built on general agentic capabilities in coding, text-based knowledge work, and GUI operations, Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash further expands audio- and video-centered agentic applications and has shown notable results in workflows that require integrated processing of text, images, audio, and video, including video editing, music video creation, film and television production and narration, audio and video to text-image summaries, and audio and video dialogue.

data.title: Nvidia Executives Disclose Stock Sales, Including 46,000 Shares Sold by CEO Jensen Huang
data.description:
Nvidia disclosed stock transactions by several executives to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, including sales by five executives totaling nearly 150,000 shares. According to ChainCatcher, CEO Jensen Huang sold about 46,000 shares at an average price of about $212 each.

Most of the transactions were related to tax withholding after restricted stock vested, rather than voluntary share reductions.
